title: Statement of Cash Flows
summary: Requires presentation of cash flows classified into operating, investing and financing activities, converged almost exactly with IAS 7, with prominent Indian relevance for working capital cycles and RBI reporting.

bannerNotice.title: Ind AS – Closely Converged with IAS 7
bannerNotice.body: Ind AS 7 reproduces IAS 7's cash flow classification and financing activities reconciliation requirements almost exactly. Its Indian practical relevance is prominent given RBI's interest in cash flow disclosures for banks/NBFCs. Section 11 covers the full comparison.
